Hakeem Jeffries on Track For Speaker Nomination in Wednesday Vote

When House Democrats gather Wednesday to choose their nominee for speaker, there will be little doubt about the outcome. Despite lingering divisions, Representative Hakeem Jeffries of New York is on course to become the first Black American to lead the chamber after steering his party to victory in this month's midterm elections.
